categories.main_business_segments: Xtep International Holdings Limited operates primarily in two segments: the mass market segment featuring the core Xtep brand, and the professional sports segment comprising the Saucony and Merrell brands. The company designs, develops, manufactures, markets, and sells sportswear products including footwear, apparel, and accessories for adults and children.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced footwear technologies such as carbon fiber plates (e.g., T400 carbon fiber), XTEP POWER kinetic energy technology, XTEP ACE injection molding foam, and big data-driven foot shape customization. Apparel technologies include moisture absorption, quick drying, cooling fibers, antibacterial and water-resistant fabrics, and sustainable materials like recycled synthetic fibers and organic cotton. Manufacturing incorporates intelligent digitalized production with 5G technology and smart factory solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Xtep serves a broad customer base including mass market consumers and professional athletes, particularly runners. It targets both elite and recreational runners in China, with a growing presence in outdoor sports enthusiasts through Merrell. The company also focuses on children’s sportswear via Xtep Kids, offering health development solutions. Major customers include participants in marathons and sports events across China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group’s operations and sales are predominantly concentrated in Mainland China, with over 8,100 stores including 6,382 Xtep Adult branded stores and 1,584 Xtep Kids stores. It also has a presence in Hong Kong and overseas markets, with brand operations and distribution subsidiaries in the British Virgin Islands and Hong Kong. The company participates in major Chinese marathons nationwide and has retail stores in key Chinese cities.
categories.supply_chain_position: Xtep operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the sportswear supply chain, encompassing design, development, manufacturing, and retail distribution. It owns and operates manufacturing facilities in Anhui and Fujian provinces and manages an extensive retail network including direct-to-consumer channels and e-commerce platforms. The company sources materials collectively and optimizes supply chain efficiency to support replenishment and growth.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group’s strategic focus is on running-led growth, emphasizing innovation in running shoe technologies and expanding its running ecosystem. It prioritizes R&D in carbon fiber plate running shoes and apparel technologies that enhance performance and comfort. The company also invests in digital retail transformation, direct-to-consumer strategies, and sustainable product design aligned with its 2030 ESG framework targeting carbon neutrality and circular economy principles.
categories.revenue_model: Xtep generates revenue primarily through product sales of footwear, apparel, and accessories via wholesale to authorized distributors, direct retail stores, and e-commerce platforms. The mass market segment contributes the majority of revenue, while the professional sports segment, including Saucony and Merrell, has shown rapid growth. The company also benefits from licensing and brand management activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Xtep positions itself as the leading running brand in China, outperforming international competitors in marathon wear rates and market share. Its diversified brand portfolio with Xtep, Saucony, and Merrell allows it to compete across mass market and professional sports segments. The company emphasizes product innovation, brand loyalty, and retail experience to maintain competitive advantage amid rising niche and premium sportswear brands.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended 2024, Xtep reported revenue of RMB13.58 billion, a 6.5% increase year-on-year, with operating profit of RMB1.97 billion and net profit attributable to equity holders of RMB1.24 billion, up 20.2%. The professional sports segment grew 57.2% in revenue, reaching RMB1.25 billion. The Group maintains a strong balance sheet with total assets of RMB15.97 billion and a gearing ratio of 18.1%. Dividend payout ratio remains high at 138.2% including special dividend.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Xtep offers high-performance, technologically advanced sportswear tailored to Chinese consumers, especially runners, combining value-for-money with elite athlete endorsements and championship-winning products. Its unique carbon fiber plate running shoes and data-driven fit technologies differentiate its footwear. The company’s strong brand ecosystem, extensive retail network, and commitment to sustainability and community engagement further enhance its competitive positioning.
